cli.reason: Ships the packaged Service Host recovery change. User CLI commands, JSON output, setup, and trace remain compatible.

service.reason: A replacement execution Host waits for identified still-running previous work and starts on its own once it exits, records process evidence per started task, and logs why local execution is paused. Unconfirmed, corrupt, and unidentifiable ownership stays fenced; Wake, result, and Host receipt contracts are unchanged, so no compatibility floor is raised.
